Priya Rao: Quick thread to lock down behavior for CP-separated private endpoints during planned maintenance vs network partition. Ops needs deterministic fallback that minimizes privacy blast radius.
Riley: Suggest we codify two modes: graceful-terminate (for planned) and passthrough-fallback (for partitions).
Samir: Definitions: maintenance = CP in read-only/maintenance mode; partition = controlplane unreachable from tenant VPC. Different probes and actions.
AJ: For maintenance: pre-warm caches, optionally terminate at edge if tenant allows. For partition: prefer passthrough->peer->regional-relay order.
Maria Chen: Important: many tenants set no_shared_egress. fallback must respect per-tenant policy and never auto-enable shared egress if disallowed.
Priya Rao: Proposal for tenant policy block: termination_allowed: true|false, fallback_priority: [peer,regional_passthrough,shared_terminate]. Default termination_allowed=false.
Riley: Implementation notes: controlplane publishes maintenance intent to routing topic; proxies prefetch TLS leafs and KV caches for tenants where termination_allowed=true.
Samir: Detection: don't rely on single heartbeat. add out-of-band probe from edge to regional relay and a synthetic request to controlplane health endpoint. combine signals.
AJ: API change: PATCH /tenants/{id} to accept fallback_policy. audit required when flipping termination_allowed from false->true for enterprise tenants.
Maria Chen: TLS: if we terminate, we need pre-provisioned fallback certs. CP may be unreachable during partition so cert issuance must be out-of-band with rotation window.
Priya Rao: Runbook snippet for ops:
1) Detect partition: probe_failures > 3 in 60s
2) Canary: route 1% traffic to regional_passthrough for 60s
3) If stable -> escalate to full fallback per tenant policy
4) If error spike -> rollback routing and page SRE
Riley: Tests: staging matrix to exercise combinations: termination_allowed (T/F), peer present (Y/N), CP maintenance vs partition, cert expiry, NAT exhaustion. I'll own harness.
Samir: Observability: emit routing.fallback.invoked (tenant,reason,mode), histogram fallback.time_to_steady_state, counter fallback.type. show top-10 affected tenants in Console.
AJ: Security guard: shared_terminate must scrub headers (X-Tenant-Id, X-Org-Meta) and strip JWTs. Add automated test that fails if header present on egress.
Maria Chen: Billing/SLA: tag fallbacks with billing_code, include in monthly report so we can credit customers if we violated SLA.
infra-bot: scheduled_maint: controlplane will be read-only 2026-05-10 03:00-03:30 UTC (automated) :calendar:
Priya Rao: Action items: Samir -> probe + health topic (ETA Thu), AJ -> API schema + audit events (ETA Fri), Riley -> staging harness (ETA next Tue), Maria -> cert fallback checklist (ETA Fri). I'll write the one-pager after these land.
AJ: Add rollback guard: if fallback increases 5xx by >3% in 3m, revert and page SRE.
Priya Rao: Thanks everyone, will follow up with runbook PR. :thumbsup:
